svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Derived sampling and checking class used by checker to register usage checks implemented as part of the transactor. The object detect class is handed a check/coverage manager in it's constructor. If this is not null, the object detect class will instantiate this class, which, in turn, will register the checks associated with the object detection code.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc::new
 (  string err_check_name = "", bit register_default_chks = 1, bit enable_default_chks = 1, uvm_report_object reporter = null, bit enable_pass_cov = 0, bit enable_fail_cov = 1, svt_mipi_lane_configuration cfg = null  ) 

CONSTRUCTOR: Create a new svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc instance.

err_check_name - A string that identifies this particular svt_err_check instance.

register_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be automatically registered.

enable_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be enabled. This bit only has meaning if register_default_checks is set to 1.

enable_pass_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the PASS checks coverage should be enabled.

enable_fail_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the FAIL checks coverage should be enabled.

cfg - Lane configuration class handle.

  function void
 svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc::register_default_checks
 (  bit enable_checks = 1  ) 

This method is called by the constructor if the register_default_checks parameter is set to 1.

enable_checks - A bit that identifies whether or not the checks those are registered by this function should be enabled or disabled.

 svt_err_check_stats  attribute
 svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc::err_sot_hs_check

Check that High Speed Sot Leader sequence should correspond to the defined value 00011101.
  • This check is applicable when single bit of High speed SOT leader sequence is corrupted in such a way that proper synchronization can still be achieved.
  • The ErrSotHS signal should remain asserted for 1 rx_word_clk_hs cycle.
  • During that period all signals will remain deasserted except RxActiveHs and RxSyncHs.

 svt_err_check_stats  attribute
 svt_mipi_ppi_common_sc::err_sot_sync_hs_check

Check that High Speed Sot Leader sequence should correspond to the defined value 00011101.
  • This check is applicable when multiple bits of High speed SOT leader sequence are corrupted in such a way that proper synchronization can not be achieved.
  • The ErrSotSyncHS signal should remain asserted for 1 rx_word_clk_hs cycle.
  • During that period all signals will remain deasserted except RxActiveHs and RxSyncHs.
